title: CmdPal: Reduce dock width jitter with fixed-width PerfMon formatting

proposed_comments.title: Scope fixed-width padding to the network dock band
proposed_comments.body:
### Scope fixed-width padding to the network dock band

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/ext/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.PerformanceMonitor/PerformanceWidgetsPage.cs` (`FormatIncomingData` and the network dock-band title updates).

**Problem:** The current change adds padding inside the shared `AsBitsPerSecString`, `AsBytesPerSecString`, and `AsBinaryBytesPerSecString` formatters. Those helpers are also used outside the network dock band, so other Performance Monitor views inherit presentation padding intended only to stabilize the band width.

**Why it matters:** Shared data-formatting behavior now depends on one presentation's layout workaround, changes visible text in unrelated views, and makes future consumers inherit unexpected spaces.

**Suggested change:**
1. Keep the shared speed formatters responsible only for natural numeric and unit text.
2. Apply fixed-width padding where `_networkUpItem` and `_networkDownItem` are initialized and updated for the dock band.
3. Preserve the rounded-boundary checks for K/M/G transitions and add focused coverage for dock-band padding.
4. Confirm ordinary Performance Monitor views retain unpadded values.

**Verification:** Build `src/modules/cmdpal/ext/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.PerformanceMonitor` and `src/modules/cmdpal/Tests/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.PerformanceMonitor.UnitTests`, run `FormatIncomingDataTests`, and manually compare network values in dock-band and non-band presentations.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans three shared formatter methods and the network dock-band call sites, so no single current RIGHT-side range safely represents the coordinated change.

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream diff changes shared formatters used beyond the dock band, while the validated fork isolates padding at the presentation boundary.
